title: Thunder's leadership book (coordinated by Cris Pop), The Storm: real leadership is the courage to face the storm inside
summary: The chapter argues that leaders watch the wrong storm: the one that matters is internal, and courage is the daily choice to move first, admit first and ask first. It closes with the story of how Thunder was born from two bold moves by Cris: asking Adi to mentor him for free, then asking Adi to build a company together. The book says Cris understood you don't wait to be chosen, you make it impossible not to choose you.

principles.text: The real storm is internal; leadership is the daily choice to face fear and step into discomfort.
principles.quote: It’s the daily, relentless choice to step into discomfort when hiding would be safer. To be the one who moves first, admits first, asks first.

principles.text: Don't wait to be chosen; create so much value that people have no choice but to notice you.
principles.quote: You don’t wait to be chosen. You make it impossible not to choose you.

principles.text: Leadership comes from being valuable, reliable and committed to the mission, not from titles or permission.
principles.quote: It’s not about titles or permission. It’s about making yourself so valuable, so reliable, so committed to the mission that people naturally want to follow you.

principles.text: Own the fix, not the credit: take responsibility when things break and others vanish.
principles.quote: the world runs on people who are willing to have their fingerprints on the fix.

principles.text: Hold to your values over approval; be kind but not merely convenient.
principles.quote: Someone who knows the difference between being kind and being convenient.

principles.text: Be willing to be a beginner long enough to become great; courage is in staying.
principles.quote: Everyone wants to be good at something. Few people want to be bad at something long enough to become good at it.
